goal: Require a dedicated bind for automatic Tor listening when explicit bind arguments are used
Prevents inbound Tor peers from being misclassified by IP and inheriting local whitelist permissions
reviewability: Ready for review, with no blockers or unaddressed concerns
agreement: Strong support with no remaining open objections (vasild, winterrdog)
